name: Tinker scalingbp spells scale by the level curve once
contract: Each tooltip applies $<scalingbp> once: Sentry Shot 706689 ($706689m1*$<scalingbp>+$AP*0.07, shown by Build: Sentry Turret 500239), Firepot 500601 ($500601m1*$<scalingbp>+$RAP*.175+$spfi*.45), Overcharge: Shield Beacon 560709 ($560709m1*$<scalingbp>+$bh*1.5, plus stamina outside the effect base), Turret Upgrade Z-15 706700 ($706700m1*$<scalingbp>+$AP*.2), Restorative Beacon 706829 ($706829m1*$<scalingbp>+$SP*0.12) and Self-Destruct 802176 (curve-scaled base plus spell and attack power). ScalingBase(L) = 0.0267291844060354 + 0.0048541098014737*L + 0.0001859597762293*L^2 is 0.0318 at level 1 and 1.6052 at level 80. The effect 0 base points are 100, 182, 815-826, 47, 125-126 and 884-889. A Tinker without gear has 25-35 attack power, 10-20 ranged attack power and no spell power at level 1, and 380-420 and 310-350 at level 80. Each bound is base*curve plus the coefficient terms over those stat ranges, truncated to an integer. Applying the curve twice gives 2, 2, 0, 0 and 30 at level 1 (Turret Upgrade cannot be told apart there) and 285, 527, 2107, 201, 322 and 2688 at level 80, all outside the bounds.
